scope: Explicit generation-aware permanent observation, retained pending proposals/revisions, received-history sealing, source and fresh public archive recovery. Not generation-aware asset/operational participant integration, independent comment/server generations, whole-room activation or platform release approval.

source.postQualificationChanges: Only this record, the observer guide, native/retained guide links and permission boundaries, and the V1 plan's scoped checkpoint note.

implementation.admission: Private per-call selection requires actual opened generation custody, exact atomic-V2 bindings, read-only native state, a zero authored prefix and no document-author receipt. Detached DTOs and caller storage overrides cannot select the path.
implementation.nativeSealing: The separately named guarded native operation requires read-only policy and zero authored prefix. It seals the existing nonempty segment without authoring atoms, resetting history, changing policy or discarding pending work. Original writable sealing still rejects read-only owners. Optional capability absence fails explicitly without weakening original generation capability detection.
implementation.readiness: Fresh account authentication, current room descriptors and original observer lease resume precede received-frame persistence and zero-clock metadata acknowledgement. Ready remains false through hydration and failed local saves; public save/flush overrides cannot manufacture the private source acknowledgement.
implementation.authority: Permanent observers never register/resume a document author, submit document groups or execute Accept. Current server roles still control Propose/Reject; an Editor regrant does not promote this transport. Saved zero clocks concern only the observer's own lane, not whole-room recovery or provider closure.
implementation.lifecycle: Factory adoption precedes automatic connect. Source retirement disposes borrowed observer transport. Live writable-policy changes fail the observer. Host policy must be supplied again on reopen; archive metadata is not a permission or credential.

tests.wireRequestCountsExcludedFromEquality: Asynchronous hint coalescing changes request timing/count only; all stable results and functional assertions remain identical.
tests.storageAndLocks: Synthetic IndexedDB and Web Locks; controlled transaction failure, not physical power loss or browser qualification.

cleanup.scope: Ignored target/deps .rlib/.rmeta/.o files only; later verification rebuilds regenerate required cache inputs.
